dialogue_text: Is this yours? I've got it. I've got it.
The egg. Bring me the egg. Up, Wick. Up.
There you go. [snorts] One at a time. Bless you.
My mother was born in Holland. We were one day away, Wick. One day.
We were one day away, Wick. One day.
Mara. Where Mara? He's from Holland. Their people and it's wearing off.
Stay here, Wick. If I call you, come.
The egg? Gone with the girl. Feed them every dawn.
Feed them every dawn. Without the heart, they wake up. And the girl, let her run to Karad. That is where
And the girl, let her run to Karad. That is where Winter goes next. Without the heart? [snorts] Stop her!
Giants are coming from Ironhorn. Hollen is burned. Aran is gone.
Giants are coming from Ironhorn. Hollen is burned. Aran is gone. Aran. And listen to me. The giants are our people.
And listen to me. The giants are our people. Don't kill them. Push again.
Push again. [groaning] Let's in firewalls. No killing.
It's coming back. Go on, Skye.
Net. Use the net. Don't kill them. [screaming]
[groaning] Without the heart, they wake up. The heart.
The heart. Wick, Ironhorn, we end this at the heart. [screaming]
heart. [screaming] Go! We hold the city!
You gave them spring. I am taking back their winter.
You gave them spring. I am taking back their winter.
This way. Out. Everyone out. Go right.
Are you feeling any better today? A little. Still cold. And you? Have you been keeping warm?
A little. Still cold. And you? Have you been keeping warm? As warm as I can. Take these. Careful, sir. How's your breathing? Better when I keep moving.
Careful, sir. How's your breathing? Better when I keep moving. Thank you, Brynn. We'll look after each other.
Hey. Hey, little one. Stay with me.
Hey. Hey, little one. Stay with me.
My mother froze in a winter like this. They took our cold, too. Not you. You hear me? Not you.
Not you. You hear me? Not you.
The smallest part of a candle, but it's the part that holds the flame.
Trying to help? That's actually useful.
That's actually useful. There you go. [music] [music]

[laughter] You're not broken. [music] You're just different.
You're not broken. [music] You're just different. Please, it's all I have.

By order of the king, all coal for the great flame.
Just a few. No one will miss a few.

Coal from the great flame. And what is this? [snorts]

Go. Run. Hold on. I'm inside.
Hold on. I'm inside. You lived.
Who gave it to you? No one gave him to me. Someone threw him away.
The beast will come for her.

Tomorrow, Rat. Don't come back quick. Please. Don't come back.
Burn it at dawn, Majesty, before it learns what it is.
The thief. Not so brave without you, little beast.
Not so brave without you, little beast. Stay away, please.
